name: Stihl
label: Stihl
summary: Stihl chain is sold through authorized dealers rather than online, so most replacement buying runs through Oregon-equivalent loops matched on pitch, gauge and drive links. Stihl's own designations (such as 61 PMM3 for the Picco Micro Mini 3 low-profile chain) are listed on each saw page next to the cross-references we could verify. Saw rows are read from STIHL's Saw Chain Selection and Identification chart in the 2025 Full Line catalog (specifications as of 1 October 2024). A few saws the 2025 chart no longer lists, such as the MS 193 and the MS 192, still cite the older chart with specifications as of 1 October 2017, and each page names the chart it uses. The MS 150 is on that 2017 chart's .050" 63 PM3 loops with the MS 211 (12"/44, 14"/50, 16"/55) and does not have a separate page.
